data.description: Get a great haircut for $10.99 at Great Clips Shoppes at Mission Trace at 965 State Road 16 in Saint Augustine. To redeem the offer now, click “Redeem Now” and present this offer on your phone at the time of payment. To redeem the offer later, just enter your email and click “Save for Later”.
data.terms_and_conditions: Valid at Great Clips Shoppes at Mission Trace at 965 State Road 16 in Saint Augustine, FL. Not valid with any other offer. Limit one coupon per customer. No copies. Taxes may apply. Expires 09/25/2026. All Great Clips® salons are independently owned and operated.
